$comment: High/critical npm advisories accepted as risks, each with a reason and a review-by date. CI (tools/npm_audit_gate.py) fails on any other high/critical advisory, on an entry past its reviewBy, and on an entry whose advisory has gone. Decision and rule: docs/working-notes/decisions/third-party-pinning.md.

accepted.reason: No fixed version (<= 4.0.7 affected). Dev-only: reached through vite, vitest, tinyglobby and fdir; not in the shipped editor bundle, nothing in editor/src imports it. The ReDoS needs an attacker-supplied glob, and the only globs it sees are our own vite/vitest config.
